dict.string: Banana schedules alarms so it can wake you at the times you turn on — ringing through silent mode and Focus, even when the app is closed.
Banana plays a playlist, album, or song from your Apple Music library as your wake-up sound after an alarm.
Banana uses the camera only when you choose to photograph a meal or a supplement label, or scan a food or supplement barcode.
Banana looks up the people you type when adding guests to an event, so “Lunch with Sam” can invite the Sam you mean.
Banana reads your workouts and health metrics from Apple Health — including sessions recorded by other apps and devices — so it can show and analyze your fitness in one place.
Banana saves your Watch-recorded workouts to Apple Health — including the route — and updates them when you trim a workout.
Banana finds your other Banana devices on this Wi-Fi so one downloaded podcast file can be reused without downloading it again.
Banana notes where you arrive and leave — only when you turn on Learn from my trips — so travel times match how long your trips really take. The visits stay on this iPhone.
Banana uses your location for forecasts, travel estimates, and—when you explicitly enable it—a route recorded only while a podcast is playing.
Banana records quick voice notes — pause a podcast, capture a thought, and it's saved with the moment it came from for later.
Banana reads whether you were on foot or in a vehicle — only when you turn on Learn from my trips — so it learns your real pace for each way of travelling.
Banana looks for photos of meals — only when you turn on Find meal photos automatically — so it can ask what you ate and log it.
Banana reads your reminders on-device so it can schedule tasks onto your day alongside your routines and meetings.
Banana transcribes downloaded episodes on your device so you can follow along word-by-word while listening.
